spec2def(wintrust.dll wintrust.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# wintrust.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wintrust-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(wintrust_shims OBJECT asn.c crypt.c register.c softpub.c wintrust_main.c)
target_link_libraries(wintrust_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libimagehlp libcrypt32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(wintrust_shims)
add_cargo_module(wintrust wintrust-cargo wintrust.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wintrust_shims psdk)
